recruitmentPunishment.title: Quality Recruiting

gain.title: What you get
gain.text: Every newcomer who stays in the city is worth over +3,000 XP to you. And when more than half of your newcomers come back, each return is worth double XP. Recruit well and you secure your special effects and your character on the plaza podium!

banner.timed: 🚨 WARNING THIS IS YOUR FINAL WARNING! You can still recruit. But on the next day of recruiting without quality your permission gets suspended.
banner.permanent: ⚠️ WARNING AT RISK! You can still recruit. But if you keep having days without quality, your permission gets suspended.

qualityDay.title: QUALITY DAY
qualityDay.text: The more newcomers come back the next day, the more you earn a Quality Day and get double XP!

sequence.title: STREAK
sequence.text: The more Quality Days in a row you get, the more XP you earn and the closer you get to the top of the ranking!

noQualityDay.title: DAY WITHOUT QUALITY
noQualityDay.text: When many newcomers don't come back the next day, you get a Day without Quality and lose XP.

punishment.title: PENALTY
punishment.text: Several Days without Quality in a row block your recruiting permission. Each new penalty will be longer than the last!

welcome.title: WELCOME THEM
welcome.text: Greet them well and don't leave the newcomer stranded. Help them take their first steps.

connect.title: CONNECT THEM
connect.text: Introduce them to your organization's crew and make them feel part of the family!

include.title: INCLUDE THEM
include.text: Invite them to activities, events or hangouts. Get them enjoying the city!

bringBack.title: BRING THEM BACK
bringBack.text: Stay close in the first days. Build a bond so they come back and stay in the city!

recruitmentPunishment.accept: I understand that not recruiting with quality leaves me without permission to recruit, and that the penalty grows each time.
recruitmentPunishment.finalCheck: I understand that recruiting without quality can suspend my permission and that new penalties will be longer.
recruitmentPunishment.finalCheckHint: Confirm the four points above to unlock this acknowledgement.

footer.timed: Your permission returns automatically when the time is up.
footer.permanent: Recruit with quality and the alert goes away on its own.
